Mean absolute error for cellular proportion vectors

Source: R/deconvolution_scorings.R
eval_MAE.Rd

The mean absolute error is: $$ \mathrm{MAE} = \frac{1}{J} \sum_{j = 1}^{J} \left|p^{obs}_{j} - \hat{p}_{j}\right|. $$

Usage

eval_MAE(p_obs, p_estimated, trim_shared_zeros = TRUE)

Arguments

p_obs

Numeric vector of observed cellular ratios.

p_estimated

Numeric vector of estimated cellular ratios.

trim_shared_zeros

Logical; if TRUE, entries where both vectors are exactly zero are removed before normalisation (e.g. jointly missing cell types).

Value

A numeric scalar score.
